root.label: Abbott halts Texas state funding for Flock cameras

events.label: Abbott halts Texas state funding for Flock cameras

slots.name: funding amount
slots.sentence: a small state agency had devoted at least $30 million toward more than 3,200 cameras across Texas.

slots.name: DPS camera count
slots.sentence: State-funded cameras include more than 900 devices operated by the Department of Public Safety, whose data was accessed once every four seconds by more than 3,000 police agencies nationwide in June.

slots.name: taxpayer money
slots.sentence: “We’ve got a half a million dollars of local taxpayer money already encumbered and paid, and (we’re) waiting for that reimbursement that the governor promised through the grant program,” Bailey said in an interview.

slots.name: agency access
slots.sentence: whose data was accessed once every four seconds by more than 3,000 police agencies nationwide in June.

slots.name: contract amount
slots.sentence: A $15 million contract with the vehicle authority was paying for almost all of the more than 900 Flock cameras they operate, and the agency intended to install hundreds more before the funding freeze.

slots.name: funding status
slots.sentence: Abbott halted state funding from being used for the AI-powered cameras in late August

slots.name: installation status
slots.sentence: Abbott also directed the Texas Department of Transportation to pause installation of new license plate readers along state roads and highways, although cameras already up can stay in place.
